brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for parents who want practical reassurance before buying. We have no approved reviews or certifications to quote. Use available product information and support without implying the home becomes child-safe.

variants.primary_text: The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit is ₹3,299 and comes with 1-to-1 installation video support. If you’re unsure how to fit childproofing items around your home, you can get guided help by video. The kit includes edge and corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet and fridge locks, and door guards. Adult supervision is still needed.
variants.headline: Childproofing kit with video support

variants.primary_text: One kit brings together childproofing items for different parts of your home: edge and corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet and fridge locks, and door guards. The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit is listed at ₹3,299, with ₹299 savings on prepaid orders. Adult supervision is still needed.
variants.headline: Six childproofing items in one kit

variants.primary_text: Want to know what support comes with your purchase? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit is ₹3,299 and includes a 30-day money-back guarantee and a 720-day replacement guarantee for eligible failures. It includes edge and corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet and fridge locks, and door guards. Adult supervision is still needed.
variants.headline: A child safety kit with stated guarantees
